concerns.text: The plan references the OpenML dataset (ID 2352) and a NIST Materials Data Repository DOI but does not include them in a “Verified Datasets” block with explicit, reachable URLs. According to Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and FR‑001, all external datasets must be cited with verified URLs. The current approach leaves the data source unverified, risking a failure of Phase 0 and violating the verified‑accuracy requirement.
